messages:
incident-bot: Alert SEV2 — hosted-api eu-west-1 request queue growing for 15m. p95 > 5s, p99 > 13s, backlog trending up. Autoscaler retries observed.

sarah (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Paging infra + eng-sre. Kicking off triage.

raj (infra): Quick snapshot: eu-west-1 GPU pool at ~100% alloc on pool-A & pool-B. Provisioner failing to create nodes: cloud API responses are 429 QuotaExceeded for vGPU allocations. Incoming rate is ~2.8x normal for last 20m. Queue size ~74,000.

maria (eng-sre): Paste from provisioner logs:
```
2024-11-09T01:42:12Z provisioner ERROR allocate request failed status=429 body={"error":"QuotaExceeded","message":"Requested 8 vGPUs, available 0"}
2024-11-09T01:42:45Z autoscaler WARN retrying allocation backoff=20s
```
Also seeing long model cold starts and KV-cache misses causing extra memory churn.

kevin (prod-eng): Two quick levers: 1) bleed non-SLA traffic to eu-central and eu-north, 2) switch low-priority routes to a smaller quantized model variant and lower token caps. Which can we flip fastest?

sarah (oncall): Applying a temporary routing split now: divert 25% of new sessions from eu-west-1 to eu-central and 10% to eu-north for non-critical tenants. Command:
```
infractl routing update --source-region eu-west-1 --targets eu-central=25,eu-north=10 --policy emergency-evac-2024
```
Monitoring for changes.

incident-bot: Routing update accepted (op id r-uz12). Telemetry should reflect in ~45s.

amber (support): Getting CS pingbacks — errors/timeouts reported by accounts t-cust-147, t-cust-334, t-cust-202. Drafting outreach and escalation notes.

raj (infra): Tried manual scale, hit cloud quota: "CreateNodes failed: QuotaExceeded: vGPU count exceeded in eu-west-1". We have an open quota request but cloud ETA is multiple hours. Could provision spot/ephemeral instances in other regions.

kevin (prod-eng): I'll enable quantized profile qp4x for the hosted default and reduce batch_max_tokens from 1024->512 for low-priority routes. Also we should enable request prioritization to favor single-turn small requests on constrained pools.

maria (eng-sre): Patching model profile and batch config:
```
modelctl set-profile redwood-open-1 --profile qp4x --routes '/v1/generate:low-priority' --ttl 3600
configctl set routing.batch_max_tokens --route low-priority --value 512
```
Applied. Expect improved eviction behavior and higher packing efficiency within 2-3 minutes.

sarah (oncall): Enforcing tenant throttles for the top noisy tenants (t-cust-147, t-cust-202) to 60% baseline while we stabilize.

raj (infra): Spinning a best-effort spot pool in eu-central labeled spot-evac-2024. Note: preemption risk. Routing already set to prefer spot pool for non-SLA traffic.

incident-bot: Spot pool request submitted (spot-evac-2024), provisioning in progress.

maria (eng-sre): Early metric update (3m after changes): queue down from 74k -> 31k. p95 dropped from ~8.9s -> ~4.2s. p99 still high (~10.8s). GPU utilization in eu-west pools decreased to ~88%.

kevin (prod-eng): Also enabled model warmup caching for hottest prefixes to reduce cold KV misses. This should help p99 tail.

amber (support): Sending proactive message to affected tenants in 10m with mitigation summary and expected stabilization timeline. Draft here: https://redwood.internal/incidents/drafts/1799912345 (internal).

raj (infra): Cloud support updated quota ticket #Q-48291 — tentative approval in 6-10 hrs. For immediate relief we're relying on regional diversion + spot pool.

maria (eng-sre): Applying a short-lived route weight change to increase diversion to eu-central by 10% more if metrics don't improve in 5m. Also creating an automated guard to throttle any tenant exceeding 3x baseline ingress.

sarah (oncall): Handoff notes for next shift: root cause = sudden fanout + cloud vGPU quota hit blocking autoscaler. Actions taken: traffic diversion (eu-central + eu-north), quantized model profile on low-priority routes, tenant throttles, spot best-effort pool, reduced batch sizes, warmup caching, and prioritization of small requests. Current status: backlog reduced ~60%, p95 improved, p99 still elevated but trending down.


david (cs): CS will hold off public comms until amber posts internal messages, then we’ll notify impacted customers. Will join postmortem to define SLAs impacted.

maria (eng-sre): Filing incident ticket INC-1799912345 with actions: (1) add quota pre-warn alerts for regional vGPU usage, (2) automated multi-region diversion when queue > threshold, (3) default quantized fallback for low-priority traffic, (4) runbook improvements. Assigning owners.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated (paging suspended). Monitoring continuation for 2h. Postmortem scheduled.

sarah (oncall): Handoff complete — I'm signing off but on-call backup raj will watch overnight. Ping @pager-duty for urgent regressions. Thanks everyone for fast work.
